visited.description: Maintains a list of visited {@link ArtifactHub}s that are federated across network hops to prevent infinite loops.

clientVersion.description:
The server version of the client making the request. Used to help {@link ArtifactHub} return data in
a compatible format.

doNotGoUpstream.description: Whether or not this request should go upstream to a central hub.

title:
A base spec of {@link ArtifactHub} APIs that inform {@link ArtifactHub} how to navigate between hubs and spokes when
not all requested information is available in the local spoke.
name: ArtifactHub.SpecBase
